sloka: मध्ये चैषां दधिमुखः प्रगृह्य तरसा तरुम् ।समभ्यधावद्वेगेन ते च सर्वे प्लवङ्गमाः ।। ५.६२.२१ ।।।।
transliteration: madhye caiṣāṁ dadhimukhaḥ pragṛhya tarasā tarum ।samabhyadhāvadvegena te ca sarve plavaṅgamāḥ ।। 5.62.21 ।।।।

translations.english: On the way, the energetic Dadhimukha took up a tree and ran to the leaping vanaras swiftly with guards following him.
